entity_raw.definition_raw:
You are able to gain some abilities of a lucid dreamer while in your corporeal form.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 15, Lucid Dreamer, Knowledge (planes) 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): Once per day, when you are in the Dimension of Dreams in your physical body, you can attempt an impossible action as a standard action as though you were in a lucid body. No positive modifiers can be applied to this roll other than your Charisma modifier.
